subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible HTTP requests ignore or tolerate a generic body `model`, and should that rule apply to Chat Completions only or to sibling endpoints too?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes a documented public API contract for model selection and provider override semantics across stable gateway HTTP APIs.

options.title: Adopt shared header precedence
options.body: Treat the body `model` as compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and update Chat Completions plus any chosen sibling endpoints with docs and tests.

options.title: Preserve agent-first body model
options.body: Keep requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>`, and document SDK integrations to send that value when using agent headers.

options.title: Decide endpoint parity first
options.body: Keep this issue open while Gateway owners choose the cross-endpoint precedence contract before another fix PR changes one path.

recommendation.title: Decide endpoint parity first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while Gateway owners choose the cross-endpoint precedence contract before another fix PR changes one path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract that the request would change.
